subject: ENGLISH
title: Detail Tracker · M01 D18
objective: Identify who, where, when, and what in a short original text.
introduction: Who? Where? When? What? Be a detail tracker and hunt for the answers hidden in short stories.

vocabulary.definition: A small piece of information in a story.
What a story or paragraph is mostly about.
A hint in the story that helps you answer who, where, when, or what.

activities.instruction: Learn to hunt for who, where, when, and what!

items.prompt: “At noon, Lani read in the library.” When did Lani read?
items.explanation: At noon tells when, so it is the time detail. In the library tells where, and Lani tells who.

items.prompt: In “Mina washed the dog in the yard,” which detail tells where?
items.explanation: In the yard tells where the washing happened. Mina is who, and the dog is what.

items.prompt: “After school, Ben played with the cat.” What did Ben play with?
items.explanation: The cat is the what — the thing Ben played with. After school tells when, and Ben is who.

items.prompt: “At noon, Lani read in the library.” Where was Lani?
items.explanation: In the library tells where Lani was. At noon tells when, and reading is what she did.

items.prompt: “Lani returned a book at the library.” What did Lani return?
items.explanation: A book is the what — the thing Lani returned. At the library tells where, and Lani is who.
